description: This file contains the implementation of the ReadSurveyService interface, providing methods to retrieve survey data, scores, and metadata from the database within the Fineract project. It includes methods for listing all surveys, retrieving specific survey details, retrieving client survey score overviews, and reading survey entries.

classes.name: ReadSurveyServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ReadSurveyService interface, providing methods to access survey data and related information from the database.

methods.name: retrieveAllSurveys
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all survey data tables with their metadata, including application and registered table names, entity subtype, and enabled status.

methods.name: retrieveSurvey
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific survey identified by surveyName, including application table, registered table name, entity subtype, and enabled status.

methods.name: retrieveClientSurveyScoreOverview
methods.description: Retrieves a list of client scores overview for a specific survey and client ID, including likelihood and poverty line data.

methods.name: retrieveClientSurveyScoreOverview
methods.description: Overloaded method that retrieves score overviews for all surveys for a given client ID, across multiple surveys.

methods.name: retrieveSurveyEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific survey entry's data for a given survey name, client ID, and entry ID.
